proposal.description: Blink timebase is held in reset through every soft-start so the retry's pattern 'starts on a fresh period', which freezes the blink phase for the whole of S_SS
proposal.reason: During a retry soft-start with strikes outstanding, Red_LED1 should keep blinking. With this fault it stays fixed at whatever phase blink had when S_SS was entered, and the blink resumes only once the converter reaches S_RUN.

proposal.description: Blink phase is cleared to dark while no strikes are outstanding, so the timebase is no longer a free-running square wave and the first strike always starts on a dark half
proposal.reason: When strike_level first goes non-zero at a moment when the free-running blink would be high, the correct Red_LED1 lights at once. With the fault it stays dark until the next terminal count, and the first visible half-period is the wrong length.

proposal.description: Over-temperature indicator is suppressed while input undervoltage is live, as if UVLO outranked OTP on the panel, when the two indicators are meant to be independent
proposal.reason: When OTP and UVLO are both live, Red_LED2 should be lit beside Red_LED3. With the fault Red_LED2 stays dark until UVLO clears.

proposal.description: Undervoltage indicator is stretched until the converter is running again, as though the UVLO comparator needed stretching, instead of showing the live condition
proposal.reason: After an input undervoltage clears, Red_LED3 should go dark on the next clock. With the fault it stays lit while the converter is in S_OFF and through soft-start, and goes dark only when run_active rises, or never if the converter does not restart.
